Name: More Space Forest Farm Map
Author: SailorDrew
Description:
[b]✨[u]NOW UPDATED FOR 1.5[/u]✨[/b]

Love the Forest Farm for the enchanting forest feel, but hate how all of the ponds and grass cut into valuable building/ farming areas? Me too! That's why I made some changes to the map, allowing more space for all of your farming endeavors. NOTE: Even though they don't show up in the pictures above, there are still logs and rocks to remove like always.

It has been updated to accommodate moving the Green House by Mikatoon in the 1.5+ versions, who graciously helped me out by doing that. ?

✧`･: How to Install :･`✧
[list=1]
[*]Download & unzip
[*]Replace the existing Farm_Foraging.xnb file ( Stardew Valley> Content> Maps) with this new file
[/list]
This mod does not require SMAPI or any sort of content patcher. Remember to back up the original Farm_Foraging.xnb file somewhere, should you decide to go back to the vanilla version of the map.
